title: Table Row/Column Disambiguation via Joint Record Resolution

phases.phase1: Verify diagnosis from EXP-028B1 field failure analysis
phases.phase2: Build structural context signals (page, row vertical corridor, column corridor, sibling co-linearity, reading order)
phases.phase4: Controlled experiments across ablation modes A through F
phases.phase5: Regression controls (6 smoke docs, non-table, tax forms, OCR corrupted)

ablation_modes.A: BASELINE (pure text match, no structural context)
ablation_modes.B: ROW_ANCHOR_ONLY (page and row vertical confinement only)
ablation_modes.E: JOINT_RECORD (joint multi-field record resolution + sibling co-linearity)
ablation_modes.F: AMBIGUITY_GATED (Mode E + abstention on indistinguishable candidates)
